quarterly_data.signal: 20-F: in 2025 Shell Lubricants' immersion cooling fluids became, in Shell's words, the first to earn Intel Data Center Certification for Immersion Cooling, with confirmed compatibility with 4th and 5th Gen Intel Xeon processors, after two years of testing; the fluids also qualify for Intel's Immersion Warranty Rider. The fluids are developed in Shell's own laboratories, are already in use at Shell data centres in Houston and Amsterdam, are PFAS-free, and draw on Shell's gas-to-liquids technology. Shell lists immersion cooling fluids to improve energy efficiency in data centres among the emerging longer-term opportunities it continued to assess.
